proves.claim: submitGateConfig returns main's affectedTests when main sets one, with no invariants or registry guards.

gate.io-submit.accepted-affected-tests-w.why: An item pinned to an older policy kept the old runner and proved under node --test after main moved to Jest.

proves.claim: submitGateConfig keeps the item's own affectedTests when main's is unset or blank.

gate.io-submit.blank-accepted-keeps-item.why: A main with no runner must not erase the runner an item names.

proves.claim: submitGatePlan over a config built from main's runner puts that runner at the start of the proof command.

gate.io-submit.plan-proof-uses-main-runn.why: The proof command is what ran under the stale runner on the trial board, so the plan itself must carry main's runner.

proves.claim: The committed accepted-main gate wins over older item-policy and candidate-only gates while accepted-main safety floors stay intact.

gate.io-submit.accepted-main-gate-wins.why: An older claim source must not retain a superseded project gate.

proves.claim: The literal gate reaches the full proof unchanged, empty accepted gates retain NO_GATE, and affectedTests precedence stays unchanged.

gate.io-submit.gate-command-kept-exact.why: Gate refresh must preserve command bytes and existing refusal and runner-selection behavior.
